title: acer sinense subsp. chingii
intro: Acer sinense subsp. chingii, commonly known as Chinese paperbark maple, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acer sinense subsp. chingii include lowering fever, relieving pain, and reducing inflammation, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant also exhibit strong antioxidant activities, which can help protect cells from oxidative damage and promote overall health.
